scope: Metric/PSD, indefinite, directed and conditional similarity geometry for JEP harm/reparation retrieval
review_type: Structured focused primary-source review; not an exhaustive PRISMA census

papers.title: Distance Metric Learning with Application to Clustering with Side-Information
papers.data_labels_language: Clustering datasets; similar/dissimilar side-information; no moral language labels.
papers.method: PSD Mahalanobis transform with similar-pair contraction and dissimilar separation.
papers.result: Establishes an inductive transform and avoids trivial collapse through dissimilar constraints.
papers.limitation: Pseudo-metric validity does not establish ethical relevance; no JEP data.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Use a standard PSD baseline; condition-specific invariance labels need independent justification.
papers.decisive_experiment: Compare frozen encoder cosine with supervised transform on fresh expert rankings.

papers.title: Distance Metric Learning for Large Margin Nearest Neighbor Classification
papers.data_labels_language: MNIST, letters, Isolet, faces, 20newsgroups; supervised classes, primarily English text in text arm.
papers.method: PSD large-margin target-neighbor pull and impostor push; local metrics extension.
papers.result: On 20newsgroups learned metric improves kNN; linear multiclass SVM remains stronger.
papers.limitation: Initial target-neighbor selection may be poor; class equivalence differs from graded ethical relevance.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Local/condition-specific spaces and supervised geometry are established.
papers.decisive_experiment: Use hard cross-topic relevant cases and same-topic condition-changing negatives; preserve stronger baseline.

papers.title: Large Scale Online Learning of Image Similarity Through Ranking
papers.data_labels_language: Web images weakly supervised by query; Caltech256 subsets; not ethical text.
papers.method: Online bilinear triplet ranking without PSD/symmetry; compares symmetrization, repeated PSD projection and final PSD projection.
papers.result: PSD can limit overfit; repeated early projection can hurt; their best PSD strategy projects after early stopping.
papers.limitation: Task-specific empirical tradeoff; not universal PSD generalization advantage.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Closest counterexample to new PSD regularization claim: this experiment already exists.
papers.decisive_experiment: Matched signed/PSD/rank/norm controls across sample sizes with unchanged Qwen.

papers.title: Generalisation Bounds for Metric and Similarity Learning
papers.data_labels_language: Theory; underlying labeled examples assumed i.i.d.; pairs dependent.
papers.method: Rademacher/U-statistic generalization analysis for symmetric pairwise losses with norm regularization, explicitly without PSD.
papers.result: Generalization bounds apply without requiring PSD.
papers.limitation: Assumptions do not cover arbitrary transcript shift; number of pairs is not independent sample size.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Capacity control rather than PSD alone can explain small-head gains.
papers.decisive_experiment: Family-held-out learning curves; bootstrap original families, not pair rows.

papers.title: Robustness and Generalization for Metric Learning
papers.data_labels_language: Theory; i.i.d. labeled examples, bounded loss and bounded/compact space assumptions.
papers.method: Algorithmic robustness analysis for metric/similarity learning, including non-PSD formulations.
papers.result: Relates train/test pair loss stability and generalization under stated assumptions.
papers.limitation: No guarantee that a synthetic paraphrase is morally invariant or that domain transfer is valid.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Condition-specific semantic invariants need labeling and held-out observation.
papers.decisive_experiment: Test invariance and selective sensitivity separately; family/transcript split.

papers.title: Learning SVM in Krein Spaces
papers.data_labels_language: Structured/vectorial classification benchmarks; not moral judgments.
papers.method: Stabilization in indefinite inner-product spaces rather than indiscriminate eigenvalue clipping.
papers.result: Provides a principled way to use indefinite similarity in SVMs.
papers.limitation: Full kernel/eigendecomposition and nonsparse solution create cost; low-rank alternative studied.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Negative eigenstructure might be signal; cannot assume it is annotation error.
papers.confidence: High method boundary; moderate JEP applicability.
papers.decisive_experiment: First test stable signed diagonal components across expert/family bootstrap before complex kernels.

papers.title: Order-Embeddings of Images and Language
papers.data_labels_language: WordNet hypernymy, image-caption matching, textual entailment; English relation labels.
papers.method: Reversed product order in nonnegative orthant with asymmetric order-violation penalty.
papers.result: Represents asymmetric hierarchical relations in shared embeddings.
papers.limitation: Reparation adequacy need not form a partial order; transitivity must be tested, not imposed.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Typed directed coverage is more defensible than harm/repair mirror symmetry.
papers.confidence: High existing-method prior; moderate intersection gap.
papers.decisive_experiment: Compare symmetric similarity with directed deficit-coverage scorer on expert need→response adequacy.

papers.title: Learning Tversky Similarity
papers.data_labels_language: a-Pascal-VOC2008 and SUN attributes; pairs same/different class; semantic binary image attributes.
papers.method: Learn common/distinct feature weights by contrastive optimization; experiments constrain alpha=beta because class labels symmetric.
papers.result: Weighted Tversky competitive with semantic Siamese; modest gains on these attribute benchmarks.
papers.limitation: Does not empirically validate asymmetric human relevance; no feature extraction or text/JEP evaluation.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Missing-deficit vs extraneous-response features could explain remedy retrieval.
papers.decisive_experiment: Annotate victim deficits, response coverage and remaining deficits; compare interpretable directed Tversky and cosine.

papers.title: Representation Learning with Weighted Inner Product for Universal Approximation of General Similarities
papers.data_labels_language: WebKB, DBLP, WordNet and English Wikipedia/Text9; links/class labels and word-similarity tests.
papers.method: Signed elementwise weighted shared-embedding inner product (WIPS); compare IPS/SIPS/IPDS and hyperbolic scores.
papers.result: Reports stronger inductive link/similarity results on several benchmarks than ordinary inner products.
papers.limitation: Universal approximation uses defined decomposable symmetric kernel class and sufficient capacity; cannot extrapolate to arbitrary directed relation.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Signed diagonal pilot head is established WIPS-like baseline, not novel geometry.
papers.decisive_experiment: Keep signed baseline; vary rank/regularization rather than claim signed weights new.

papers.title: Tversky Neural Networks: Psychologically Plausible Deep Learning with Differentiable Tversky Similarity
papers.data_labels_language: MNIST, NABirds, English PTB; classification/language modeling, not human moral retrieval.
papers.method: Differentiable feature/prototype contrast similarity replacing projection layers; asymmetric weights.
papers.result: Reports gains in image adaptation and some language-model settings; frozen-backbone adapters relevant.
papers.limitation: Capacity/normalization/init and pretrained-weight compatibility confounds; their wording about dot products as metrics should not be adopted.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Potential readout baseline without backbone retraining; no validated moral advantage.
papers.decisive_experiment: Capacity-matched small directed readout vs linear/PSD/signed with frozen encoder.

papers.title: Semantic Conditional Similarity (SCS): A Formal Mathematical Framework
papers.data_labels_language: Synthetic letter-lemma sets; lexical document representation; no JEP expert retrieval benchmark.
papers.method: Subtract shared source-document lemma content then compare residuals; roles induce triple-wise asymmetry.
papers.result: Demonstrates marginal-contribution ranking reversals numerically, not moral reasoning gain.
papers.limitation: Lexical sets lose composition/negation/paraphrase; residualization differs from ethical aspect conditioning.
papers.jep_gap_or_relevance: Cheap marginal attribution baseline; does not replace explicit theory/need condition.
papers.confidence: High distinction; low evidence of JEP applicability.
papers.decisive_experiment: Evaluate residualization only against verified evidence coverage with Spanish lexical/negation counterexamples.

inclusion: Primary methods/theory with inspectable relevant sections; explicit geometry, asymmetry, capacity or conditional relation bearing on experiment. Preprints labeled.
exclusion: Secondary summaries, abstract-only results treated as deep, generic embedding papers lacking a concrete relevant constraint, and unsupported moral-reasoning extrapolation.
snowballing: WIPS references→indefinite/Krein and shifted inner products
coverage_limits: No independent Spanish/Colombian expert retrieval evidence established in this geometry stream. No claim that all legal/restorative applications have been exhausted. Some older theoretical papers use arXiv author versions; identify inspected version. Literature claims confined to inspected sections.
pilot_alignment: Read retained pilot README on canonical Columbia VM. PSD small heads beat matched signed heads but not unchanged Qwen; straightforward conditioning already at synthetic ceiling; relation translation loses to cosine; MET-D views incomplete.
